response.title: what size solar generator to run a freezer
response.answer:
For a typical household freezer, I recommend a solar generator with a 1,000–2,000 Wh battery, a 1,000–2,000 W inverter, and 400–600 W of solar panels.

The exact size depends on the freezer's electricity consumption and how long you need it to run.

Recommended solar generator sizes

Freezer type

	

Daily energy use (estimate)

	

Recommended battery




Small chest freezer (5–7 cu ft)

600–1,000 Wh

	

1,500–2,000 Wh




Large chest freezer (16–22 cu ft)

	

800–1,500 Wh

	

2,000–3,000 Wh




Upright freezer (15–20 cu ft)

	

900–1,800 Wh

	

2,000–4,000 Wh

These are planning estimates; actual usage varies with age, ambient temperature, and efficiency.

How long will a solar generator run a freezer?

Assuming the freezer consumes 800 Wh per day and accounting for approximately 15% conversion losses:

1,000 Wh battery

25 hours

2,000 Wh battery

51 hours

3,000 Wh battery

76 hours

4,000 Wh battery

102 hours

Estimated runtime without solar charging, starting with a full battery.
Solar panel requirements

For a freezer consuming 800 Wh per day:

200 W solar: May be sufficient on sunny days with favorable conditions.

400 W solar: Better for reliably replenishing daily consumption.

600–800 W solar: Provides additional margin for cloudy conditions and winter.

Solar production depends heavily on location, season, shading, and weather.

Important: Freezer compressors require extra power when starting. Look for a pure sine wave inverter rated at least 1,000 W continuous with sufficient surge capacity, often 2,000 W or more.

For a typical household freezer, I recommend a **solar generator with a 1,000–2,000 Wh battery, a 1,000–2,000 W inverter, and 400–600 W of solar panels**.

The exact size depends on the freezer's electricity consumption and how long you need it to run.

## Recommended solar generator sizes

| Freezer type | Daily energy use (estimate) | Recommended battery |
|---|---:|---:|
| Small chest freezer (5–7 cu ft) | 400–700 Wh | 1,000 Wh |
| Medium chest freezer (10–15 cu ft) | 600–1,000 Wh | 1,500–2,000 Wh |
| Large chest freezer (16–22 cu ft) | 800–1,500 Wh | 2,000–3,000 Wh |
| Upright freezer (15–20 cu ft) | 900–1,800 Wh | 2,000–4,000 Wh |

These are planning estimates; actual usage varies with age, ambient temperature, and efficiency.

## How long will a solar generator run a freezer?

Assuming the freezer consumes 800 Wh per day and accounting for approximately 15% conversion losses:

<box gap={3}>
  {#each [{w:1000,h:25},{w:2000,h:51},{w:3000,h:76},{w:4000,h:102}] as b}
    <box gap={1} key={b.w}>
      <row align="center" justify="between">
        <text weight="medium">{(b.w/1000).toFixed(0)},000 Wh battery</text>
        <text weight="medium" tabularNums>{b.h} hours</text>
      </row>
      <box background="surface-tertiary" height="12px" radius="full" clip>
        <box background="rgba(35,139,91,0.85)" width={`${b.h/102*100}%`} height="100%" radius="full"/>
      </box>
    </box>
  {/each}
  <caption>Estimated runtime without solar charging, starting with a full battery.</caption>
</box>

## Solar panel requirements

For a freezer consuming 800 Wh per day:

- **200 W solar:** May be sufficient on sunny days with favorable conditions.
- **400 W solar:** Better for reliably replenishing daily consumption.
- **600–800 W solar:** Provides additional margin for cloudy conditions and winter.

Solar production depends heavily on location, season, shading, and weather.

**Important:** Freezer compressors require extra power when starting. Look for a pure sine wave inverter rated at least 1,000 W continuous with sufficient surge capacity, often 2,000 W or more.

## Three questions to size yours accurately

{@body const [type,setType]=DIL.useState("medium")}
{@body const [duration,setDuration]=DIL.useState("24")}
{@body const [solar,setSolar]=DIL.useState("yes")}
<box border radius="xl" padding={3} gap={3}>
  <form gap={3} onSubmit={()=>GenUI.issueNewTurn(`Size a solar generator for my ${type} freezer, for ${duration} hours of backup, with solar panel recharging: ${solar}. Recommend battery capacity, inverter size and solar panel wattage.`)}>
    <box gap={1}>
      <label>1. What type of freezer?</label>
      <radio-group direction="col" value={type} onChange={setType}>
        <radio value="small chest (5–7 cu ft)">Small chest freezer (5–7 cu ft)</radio>
        <radio value="medium chest (10–15 cu ft)">Medium chest freezer (10–15 cu ft)</radio>
        <radio value="large chest (16–22 cu ft)">Large chest freezer (16–22 cu ft)</radio>
        <radio value="upright">Upright freezer</radio>
      </radio-group>
    </box>
    <divider color="subtle"/>
    <box gap={1}>
      <label>2. How long do you need it to run?</label>
      <radio-group direction="col" value={duration} onChange={setDuration}>
        <radio value="12">12 hours</radio>
        <radio value="24">24 hours</radio>
        <radio value="48">48 hours</radio>
        <radio value="continuous">Continuously, off-grid</radio>
      </radio-group>
    </box>
    <divider color="subtle"/>
    <box gap={1}>
      <label>3. Will you recharge using solar panels?</label>
      <radio-group direction="row" value={solar} onChange={setSolar}>
        <radio value="yes">Yes</radio>
        <radio value="no">No</radio>
      </radio-group>
    </box>
    <button submit block>Calculate my solar generator size <icon name="arrow-right" inline/></button>
  </form>
</box>
